actions.name: Round Trip
actions.description:
Trigger: A creature on the user's Team is targeted by an Attack..

Effect: The user freely targets the triggering creature with @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-moves.MXPyYtoPDsZ4ByPh]{Recall} and then freely uses @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-moves.XJ6olVrexEHDTqTM]{Send Out} with another creature in their Team, who takes the place of the triggering creature and made the target of the triggering Attack, as per Intercept.

system.description: Effect: When a creature on the user's Team is targeted by an Attack, the user may, as a Complex Action @Trait[interrupt] at @Trait[priority-30], freely target that creature with @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-moves.MXPyYtoPDsZ4ByPh]{Recall} and then freely use @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-moves.XJ6olVrexEHDTqTM]{Send Out} with another creature in their Team, who takes take place of the triggering creature and is made the target of the triggering Attack, as per Intercept.
